definitions.articularis genu muscle: A muscle organ of the anterior thigh, often described as a deep, flat, variable accessory of the quadriceps femoris that arises from the anterior surface of the distal femur and inserts onto the suprapatellar bursa and synovial membrane of the knee joint, retracting the joint capsule during knee extension.

unresolvable.label: articularis genu muscle
